title: Grilled Mediterranean Eggplant Skewers
description: A flavorful and healthy vegetarian dish perfect for warm weather. These eggplant skewers are marinated in a mix of Mediterranean spices and grilled to perfection.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic powder, and dried oregano.
Add eggplant cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread eggplant cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the eggplant skewers with the remaining marinade.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
If using breadcrumbs, sprinkle them over the eggplant skewers.
Grill the eggplant skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until they're tender and lightly charred.
